text:
Maya: Heads up — during today's 18:00 PST change window I'd like to land two deploy tooling changes: 1) new /deploy bot flags for --change-window and --pin-version, 2) a standardized release-notes template and a quick rollback script. Can we discuss?

DeployBot: /deploy start --service=runtime --version=v2.3.0 --change-window=2024-06-25T18:00Z --pin-version=true (preview)

Sam K: Love it — especially pin-version. Two questions: how will pin interact with automated rollouts? And who owns the template?

Jonah L: Pin should create an immutable alias for the model — runtime will route to alias. Rollout still possible by creating new alias + updating route; bot will warn. I'll own the template and add it as PR template under .github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md

Maya: Awesome. Can someone draft the bot commands syntax and a rollback script we can test in staging?

Elena: I'll sketch commands. Idea: /deploy start --service runtime --version v2.3.0 --change-window '2024-06-25T18:00Z/2024-06-25T20:00Z' --pin-version true --template release/runtime

Elena: ```
/deploy start --service runtime --version v2.3.0 --change-window=2024-06-25T18:00Z/2024-06-25T19:00Z --pin-version
/deploy rollback --service runtime --to-version v2.2.8 --reason "regression in latency"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
SERVICE=$1
TO=$2
# quick rollback
deployctl update --service $SERVICE --version $TO --force
deployctl notify --channel #eng-oncall "Rollback $SERVICE -> $TO"
```

DeployBot: Scheduled change window created: id cw-20240625-1, ETA 2024-06-25T18:00Z. Reminder will post 30m before.

Tariq: Can we add preflight checks? e.g., smoke test + canary traffic 5% + metrics thresholds.

Jonah L: Yes — propose minimal preflight: healthcheck /health, smoke sample endpoint, latency <= 200ms p95, error rate < 0.1% for 5m. If fails -> auto-rollback. I'll add bot flags --preflight=(smoke,metrics) and thresholds.

Sam K: :thumbsup: Can you also add a release notes template? I'll paste a starter.

Sam K: ```
Release notes - runtime service
Version: v2.3.0
Change window: 2024-06-25T18:00Z/2024-06-25T19:00Z
Summary: short bullets
Risk: low/medium/high
Rollback plan: steps
Monitoring: dashboards + runbook links
Contacts: @oncall @eng-sre
```

Maya: Perfect. Let's turn these into a PR: infra/deploy-bot/commands.md, scripts/rollback.sh, .github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md. Jonah + Elena to own. I'll create the issue.

DeployBot: Created issue #1423 "Tooling: structured deploy commands + templates" and assigned to Jonah L, Elena, Maya.

Elena: I'll start a draft PR this afternoon and add tests for preflight checks. ETA EOD.

Sam K: If you want me to review, ping me. Also add a 'dry-run' flag to bot so QA can exercise.

Maya: Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
